summary: Specifies how to authenticate PIM-SM link-local messages with IPsec ESP, or optionally AH, and how to add confidentiality with ESP. Manual keying is the mandatory default, with other mechanisms considered for scalability and security. It is a proposed standard.

eli5.summary: Neighboring routers put a seal on the notes they pass to each other, so fake notes from an imposter get ignored.

questions: how to secure pim-sm hello messages
